mostWorthwhile.text: Using the prepared box in the dark room was most worthwhile: it produced a concrete inverted image and connected the instrument to light passing through an opening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the box was the least engaging moment on its own; it gave no explanation until the following action.

surprise.text: The image-formation explanation left me wanting to know more about why the image inverts, rather than just that it does.

arbitrary.text: No action felt wholly arbitrary, though combining the finished lens with a geometric account was an abstract way to produce a close-up view.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue for another chapter: the instruments and their visible effects were appealing, but I would hope for more detailed explanations of the optics.
